tools.name: search_biomedical_literature
tools.description: Semantically search Noodle's public PubMed-derived biomedical corpus. Include known PMID, DOI, or PMCID identifiers in the query so they can act as exact anchors. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: get_publication_details
tools.description: Retrieve one complete public bibliographic record by PMID after search. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: get_work_details
tools.description: Retrieve one complete public bibliographic record by Noodle work identifier. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: get_publication_neighborhood
tools.description: Retrieve the bounded citation and semantic neighborhood around one PMID. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: get_work_neighborhood
tools.description: Retrieve the bounded citation and semantic neighborhood around one Noodle work identifier. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: get_corpus_summary
tools.description: Return public corpus coverage, source, freshness, and count metadata. Results are for literature discovery and professional review, not diagnosis or treatment.

tools.name: support_helena
tools.description: Learn about the separate Helena Good MCP. This opt-in information action initiates no payment or outreach and changes no scientific result.
